landing.title: Card auctions in your WhatsApp group
landing.description: Run card auctions in your WhatsApp group and keep sales, buyers and settlements organized in one place.
landing.subtitle: A tool for trading card stores to run auctions and keep their sales organized.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: No password. We send a code to your e-mail.
login.inviteOnly: Access is by invitation only. No invitation?

code.title: Enter the code
code.label: 6-digit code
code.resent: We sent a new code to {email}.

validation.otpCode: Enter the 6 digits of the code.
validation.phone: Enter the number with the area code.
validation.dateTime: Enter a valid date and time.
validation.endFuture: The end must be in the future.
validation.endAfterStart: The end must be after the start.
validation.money: Enter an amount above zero, like 25 or 25.50.
validation.ceilingAbove: The ceiling must be above the opening bid.
validation.cpf: Enter the 11 digits of the CPF.
validation.cep: Enter the 8 digits of the postal code (CEP).
validation.state: Enter the 2 letters of the state, like SP.
validation.days: Enter a whole number of days, 1 or more.
